note: Evil Mode founding: the six Creeds (design Part 3 sections 4 and 11). Starting values, not playtested.

creeds.name: Profit
creeds.line: Everything costs. We'd like to be paid.

creeds.name: Cause
creeds.line: Something's wrong, and nobody's fixing it.
creeds.pays: Works and broadcasts, in Regard and recruits
creeds.also: The sentence, painted on a bedsheet

creeds.name: Power
creeds.line: Somebody's going to be in charge.
creeds.pays: Holdings by Outplay or Bend count double

creeds.name: Wonder
creeds.line: There's a door. We'd like to see behind it.

creeds.name: Belonging
creeds.pays: Nothing. It starts with the highest Loyalty

creeds.name: Spite
creeds.line: One person. That's all we want.
creeds.pays: Exposures: Regard and Dread move twice as far
